title: 第25章 宝灵葫芦第26章 加点
content_zh:
出了城后，路况没有城里的好，一路摇摇晃晃，易长生觉得，要不是他已经是后天三重的武者，他觉得自己会被颠吐的。
马车实在是太颠簸了，体验感非常的差，还好他已经练武了，坐久后也习惯了一些，否则大几天的路程就很难过。
镖局车队刚开始一天非常顺利，但在第二天的傍晚，易长生的虚维之眼就发现了不远处的山那边有山匪出现。
车队停下来休息的时候，他下意识便把虚维之眼放到各处查看。
这一看就看到了山匪，不过，可能是见到车队这么多人，而且后天七重八重，就连九重境的武者就有好几个，他们商量了一下就没敢对镖局车队下手。
这让易长生松了一口气。
接着他不仅用虚维之眼观察周围，镖头和那些家族的家主的身上，以及他们行李他也都翻看了一下。
他想要地图，不管是景松城的，还是同安城和凤鸣城的，易长生都想要。
好在镖头身上有几张地图，其他家主也有一些，勉强让他得知一些这一路大概的情况。
之后都遇到一些马贼和山匪，但这些马贼山匪，探到车队的情况后，都知难而退了。
到了第三天的中午，车队终于到了同安郡城。
进了同安群城后，可以看得出来，众人都松了一口气。
镖头给大家交代了一下后，全都住进同安郡通达镖局分部安排好的一客栈里。
易长生在客房里用虚维之眼观察了半晌，没发现什么异样后，就想着出去逛古玩街了。
今天会在同安城休息一天，明天早上再继续出发去凤鸣城。
他估算了一下时间，时间还早，起码可以逛一个下午的古玩街。
想着，易长生交代了一下车夫后，就向客栈的伙计打听一下古玩街在哪，得到位置后，就直奔而去。
同安城的古玩街比景松城的要大多了，这里的古玩街不叫街，而叫市，古玩市。
易长生刚到就发现了不少带有星光的物件了，他心里非常兴奋，但面上却不显，一副公子哥游玩好奇的样子，慢悠悠地逛着摊位。
他一边逛一边收集物件上的维点，逛到中心一点的位置时，突然就发现虚维之眼全知视角的边缘处，有一个非常显眼的紫色星光。

紫色的星光？
会是修仙界的灵物吗？
易长生非常兴奋，细看了一眼那个位置，记下后他也没急着去，而是一边收集维点，一边往着那边走。
没过多久，他就到了星光的位置上，是一个杂物摊贩，上面什么乱七八糟的的东西都有。
不过，在虚维之眼的全知视角之下，他发现摊位上起码有好几件东西应该都是真的古董，而且像是刚出土不久的样子。
他看了一眼摊贩，平平无奇，很矮，年纪应该在三十多岁左右，但看起来就像是一个小老头。
易长生心想，这个不会是个摸金校尉吧？
他也没再多猜测，蹲下来装作好奇的样子，打量着摊位上的东西，余光看向那个发出紫色星光的东西。
是一个两指大小的小葫芦，定睛细看时，上面显示出了几个紫色的文字【宝灵葫芦】。
content_en:
After leaving the city, the road conditions were not as good as those in the city. It was shaky along the way. Yi Changsheng felt that if he hadn't been a third-level acquired warrior, he would have been vomited.
The carriage was too bumpy and the experience was very poor. Fortunately, he had already practiced martial arts and got used to it after sitting for a long time. Otherwise, the journey of several days would have been difficult.
The escort team's first day went smoothly, but in the evening of the second day, Yi Changsheng's virtual eyes discovered bandits appearing on the other side of the mountain not far away.
When the convoy stopped to rest, he subconsciously put the Eye of Virtual Dimension everywhere to check.
At this glance, they saw the bandits. However, maybe because they saw so many people in the convoy, and there were several warriors at the seventh, eighth, and even ninth level the day after tomorrow, they didn't dare to attack the Escort convoy after discussing it.
This made Yi Changsheng breathe a sigh of relief.
Then he not only observed the surroundings with the Eye of Xuwei, he also looked through the bodyguards and heads of the families, as well as their luggage.
He wanted maps, whether they were from Jingsong City, Tongan City, or Fengming City, Yi Changsheng wanted them all.
Fortunately, the escort had a few maps with him, and other family heads also had some, which barely allowed him to get some general information about the situation along the way.
Later, they encountered some horse thieves and bandits, but these horse thieves and bandits retreated after discovering the situation of the convoy.
At noon on the third day, the convoy finally arrived at Tong'an County.
After entering Tong'an City, it can be seen that everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
After the escort chief gave everyone an explanation, they all stayed in an inn arranged by the Tongda Escort Bureau branch in Tong'an County.
Yi Changsheng observed for a long time in the guest room with the Eye of Virtual Reality. After finding nothing unusual, he thought about going out to visit the antique street.
Today we will have a day of rest in Tong'an City, and we will continue our journey to Fengming City tomorrow morning.
He estimated the time. It was still early, and he could at least spend an afternoon browsing the antique street.
Thinking about it, after Yi Changsheng told the driver, he asked the inn clerk where the antique street was. After getting the location, he went straight there.
The antique street in Tong'an City is much larger than that in Jingsong City. The antique street here is not called a street, but a market, an antique market.
When Yi Changsheng arrived, he discovered many objects with starlight. He was very excited in his heart, but he didn't show it on his face. He looked like a young man out for fun, strolling around the stalls slowly.
As he walked around, he collected dimensional points on the objects. When he reached the center, he suddenly discovered a very conspicuous purple starlight at the edge of the omniscient perspective of the virtual dimensional eye.
Purple starlight?
Could it be a spiritual creature from the world of immortality?
Yi Changsheng was very excited. He took a closer look at the location. After writing it down, he didn't rush there. Instead, he collected dimension points and walked there.
It didn't take long for him to arrive at Starlight's location, which was a sundry vendor with all sorts of messy things on it.
However, under the omniscient perspective of the Eye of Xuwei, he discovered that at least several items on the stall should be real antiques, and they seemed to have been unearthed not long ago.
He glanced at the vendor. He was ordinary and short. He should be around thirty years old, but he looked like a little old man.
Yi Changsheng thought to himself, could this be a gold-enhancing captain?
He didn't speculate any more, squatted down and pretended to be curious, looking at the things on the stall, and looking at the thing that glowed with purple stars out of the corner of his eye.
It is a small gourd the size of two fingers. When you look closely, you can see several purple words on it [Precious Spirit Gourd].
